charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1101_0100_2:
On [EN:Gen Ref="255" M="his" F="her" ] way back from exploring,
[Name:PlayerNickname ] happened upon
Mars and called out to her.
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0200_1:
Oh, if it isn’t [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Did you need something?
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0300_1: Huh? You’re curious about my Purugly?
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0400_1:
Hehe! All right, then! As a special treat,
I’ll give you a closer look!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0500_1:
A real beauty, isn’t she? She’s my partner
and pride and joy!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0600_1:
I’ve raised her to be stronger and more
beautiful than any Pokémon around!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0700_1:
Back in Sinnoh, Team Galactic missions kept
me so busy, I never had time...
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_0800_1:
but if I’d entered contests with her, I bet
we’d be standing on top by now!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_0401_1100_1: With her charm, we’d win for sure!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_0402_1300_1: Hmph! Of course! She’s my partner, after all!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_1400_1: But...I guess it might not be easy.
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_1500_1:
I’ve heard in the contests in Sinnoh, there’s a
really strong Kangaskhan Trainer.
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_1600_1:
What’s the matter, Purugly? Trying to tell me
to have more confidence?
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_1700_1:
Hehe! You’re right! If it’s the two of us,
we’re sure to reach the top!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_1800_1:
Some people in Team Galactic see Pokémon
as tools.
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_1900_1:
But I shower my partner with pure,
unmistakable love!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_2000_1:
I took great care in raising her, so while her
beauty is a given, her strength is top too!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_2100_1:
Anyone can tell we’re the best sync pair in
Team Galactic!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_0401_2300_1: What are you saying? That’s impossible!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_0401_2400_1:
Master Cyrus is an exception! He’s on a
whole different level from regular sync
pairs like us!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_0402_2600_1:
That’s right! We’re the best, without a doubt!
That is...
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_0402_2700_1: only if you don’t count Master Cyrus!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_2800_1: Why are you looking at me like that?!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_3100_1:
I’ll prove to you—right here, right now—just
how strong Purugly and I are!
charaepi_ch0225_00_mars/2301_1201_3300_1:
If you lose, you’ll get no forgiveness from
me—no matter how sad and sorry you are!
